The Cardinal were led by third-year head coach [[Johnny Dawkins]], and played their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]] as a member of the [[Pacific-10 Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2009–10 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Cardinal]] played in the [[Cancún Challenge]] and were able to reach the championship round in the Riviera division and play against #5 ranked [[2009–10 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]], but lost in overtime 73–65. Stanford finished below .500 in conference play for the second year in a row under coach Dawkins. They finished tied for 7th in conference play with [[2009–10 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]] and had the tiebreaker over them, beating them twice during the season. Stanford played [[2009–10 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] in the first round and upset the #2 seed Sun Devils 70–61. In the semifinals they played #3 seed [[2009–10 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] but lost 79–64.
